model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the percentage of employed individuals across different age groups, categorized by their migration background. The x-axis, labeled "Alter" (age), is linear, ranging from 20 to 70 years, with a tick label interval of 10 years. The y-axis, labeled "Anteil Erwerbstätige in %" (percentage of employed individuals), is also linear, spanning from 0% to 100%, with a tick label interval of 20%. The plot features four lines representing different migration categories: "ohne Migrationshintergrund" (without migration background) in black, "in Deutschland geboren" (born in Germany) in gray, "zugewandert bis 2009" (immigrated until 2009) in light blue, and "zugewandert seit 2010" (immigrated since 2010) in dark blue. 

The black line, representing individuals without a migration background, starts at around 60% at age 20, increases to approximately 90% between ages 25 and 55, and then declines to nearly 0% at age 70. The gray line, representing those born in Germany, follows a similar trend, starting at around 60% at age 20, peaking at around 85% between ages 30 and 50, and decreasing to nearly 0% at age 70. The light blue line, representing individuals who immigrated until 2009, begins at around 40% at age 20, rises to approximately 80% between ages 30 and 50, and then drops to nearly 0% at age 70. The dark blue line, representing those who immigrated since 2010, starts at around 30% at age 20, fluctuates between 30% and 60% until age 60, and then decreases to nearly 0% at age 70.
